display.note: Stand-in for Majesty Light, which is commercial and not yet licensed. Same stand-in the live site uses (site/src/styles/fonts.css). To switch: drop Majesty's woff2 into fonts/ and add it below with weight 300.

voiceSummary: An experienced medical aesthetics practitioner speaking directly to a patient: knowledgeable, honest and reassuring, never clinical, corporate or polished. Plain British English. 'You' for the reader, 'we' for PureMed, Nafisa's first person where natural. Consultation-led, never pushy. Never promise perfection, guaranteed or permanent results. Never make the reader feel embarrassed about ageing. No em dashes, ever.
